description: Red-Black Tree insertion balancing terminates recoloring loop early without updating z to grandparent, violating RB invariants.
spec_notes: RedBlackTree._fixup_insertion must advance z = gp when recoloring red uncle nodes.

"""Red-Black Tree node definitions."""

from typing import Optional


RED = True
BLACK = False


class RBNode:
    def __init__(self, val: int, color: bool = RED):
        self.val = val
        self.color = color
        self.left: Optional["RBNode"] = None
        self.right: Optional["RBNode"] = None
        self.parent: Optional["RBNode"] = None

from rb_tree import RedBlackTree
from visualizer import RBValidator


def test_root_insertion_is_black():
    tree = RedBlackTree()
    tree.insert(10)
    assert tree.root is not None
    assert RBValidator.validate_invariants(tree) is True


def test_simple_rotations():
    tree = RedBlackTree()
    for val in [10, 20, 30]:
        tree.insert(val)
    assert RBValidator.validate_invariants(tree) is True
    assert tree.root.val == 20


def test_uncle_recoloring_cascading_propagation():
    tree = RedBlackTree()
    # Sequence triggering cascading uncle recoloring and rotation at root
    for val in [50, 20, 80, 10, 30, 5, 25]:
        tree.insert(val)
        assert RBValidator.validate_invariants(tree) is True


def test_large_sequential_inserts():
    tree = RedBlackTree()
    for i in range(1, 25):
        tree.insert(i)
    assert RBValidator.validate_invariants(tree) is True


def test_inorder_binary_search_invariant():
    tree = RedBlackTree()
    values = [15, 8, 24, 4, 11, 19, 30, 2, 7]
    for v in values:
        tree.insert(v)
    inorder: list[int] = []
    def traverse(node):
        if not node: return
        traverse(node.left)
        inorder.append(node.val)
        traverse(node.right)
    traverse(tree.root)
    assert inorder == sorted(values)
    assert RBValidator.validate_invariants(tree) is True


def test_reverse_ordered_inserts():
    tree = RedBlackTree()
    for i in range(20, 0, -1):
        tree.insert(i)
    assert RBValidator.validate_invariants(tree) is True
